title: Diagnose the signal before changing the model
description: Combine curve shape, generalization gap, gradient behavior, and data evidence. A plausible intervention is not evidence that it treats the active failure.

curves.label: Validation reverses
curves.detail: Training loss falls while held-out loss starts rising.

curves.label: Both curves plateau
curves.detail: Neither training nor validation improves after early progress.

curves.label: Loss spikes
curves.detail: The optimization path is erratic rather than steadily improving.

curves.label: Validation looks implausibly good
curves.detail: Held-out loss is much lower than training loss from the first epoch.

gaps.label: Wide
gaps.detail: Validation is 1.3 loss above training late in the run.

gaps.label: Inverted
gaps.detail: Validation is unexpectedly better than training.

gradients.label: Stable norms
gradients.detail: Norms remain inside the expected band.

gradients.label: Vanishing
gradients.detail: Updates are near zero for most layers.

gradients.label: Exploding
gradients.detail: Norms jump by orders of magnitude.

dataConditions.label: No known data issue
dataConditions.detail: Schema checks and split ownership are current.

dataConditions.label: Leakage suspected
dataConditions.detail: A feature may contain future, duplicated, or target-derived information.

dataConditions.label: Labels or inputs are noisy
dataConditions.detail: Annotation disagreement or corrupted inputs increased.

interventions.label: Regularize and stop early
interventions.detail: Add regularization and use a protected validation checkpoint.

interventions.label: Lower rate and clip gradients
interventions.detail: Reduce the update size, enable clipping, and rerun a short control.

interventions.label: Audit splits and features
interventions.detail: Rebuild the split from entity and time boundaries before another run.

interventions.label: Repair labels and sample errors
interventions.detail: Review disagreement slices, repair labels, and compare a clean holdout.

interventions.label: Increase signal or capacity
interventions.detail: Check feature coverage and model capacity using a small, controlled ablation.
